note: Filled from local runs and CI runs on 2026-11-15. Portal branch feat/app-platform-licence-gate (PR 447, cut from integration/app-platform at 16e38a98); Apps branch feat/licence-gate (PR 41, main merged in after PR 40). environment.go: 1.27.1 locally (go 1.26.11 in go.mod; CI uses the go.mod version)

implemented.policy: scripts/licence-policy.json: allow (12 SPDX ids), deny (GPL-2.0-only, SSPL-1.0, BUSL-1.1, Commons-Clause, EPL-1.0, EPL-2.0 and others), own licence AGPL-3.0-only for named own components, election-only FTL, elections (dompurify to Apache-2.0, github.com/golang/freetype to FTL), exclusion (elkjs, requires elk-build-test)
implemented.evaluator: scripts/licence_scan.py: SPDX OR/AND/parentheses, WITH kept opaque, several licence entries ANDed, fails closed on unknown, missing and unparseable licences and on an empty SBOM, exit 0/1/2, JSON report
implemented.elk: web/vite.config.ts aliases ^elkjs(/.*)?$ to web/src/lib/elkDisabled.ts (throws on construction); forbidElkjs Rollup plugin (web/scripts/forbid-elkjs.mjs) fails the build if any module id lies under node_modules/elkjs/ (verified: the build fails with the alias removed); web/scripts/check-no-elk.mjs scans the output for org.eclipse.elk.alg., org.eclipse.elk.core., ELKNode, elk-worker.min.js, elk-api.js as a second layer; dagre is requested through layoutForDiagram for flowchart, state, class, ER and requirement diagrams and left unset for mind maps (Mermaid 12.1 would otherwise default them to ELK)
implemented.ci: Portal .github/workflows/licence.yml (dedicated workflow; push to main and integration/app-platform, pull requests, dispatch; Go SBOM for all six release platforms; npm production SBOM; ELK build test; scan); Apps .github/workflows/check.yml job licence (Go SBOM for the six status release targets; npm production SBOM; check_licence_copy.py; scan with --workspace-root)
implemented.apps_declarations: root, @portal-app/sdk, portal-status-ui, portal-symbols-demo and the status acceptance harness package.json declare AGPL-3.0-only; scripts/tests/test_licence_scan.py fails if one stops
implemented.reviewed_as: Per-component reviewed-as records pinned to the SHA-256 of the licence file read from the Go module cache or node_modules in CI, and to the exact declared expression; a changed hash, changed declaration, missing file or version mismatch makes the record stale and the gate fails again; a record cannot override a denied licence
implemented.nested_components: Components are walked recursively and de-duplicated by bom-ref; cyclonedx-npm nests packages that are not hoisted (18 in the Portal SBOM, 2 in Apps)
implemented.own_workspace: An own npm component must be a package of the repository's npm workspaces (--workspace-root) with no registry distribution
implemented.elections: An election's elected licence must be an OR operand of the pinned (offered) declaration; freetype carries offered 'GPL-2.0-or-later OR FTL'
implemented.licence_files: npm licence file read from the SBOM's install path (cdx:npm:package:path); installed package.json version must equal the component version; roots escaping node_modules or the module cache are refused; licence entries with only a url or text fail as unknown
implemented.copy_check: Apps scripts/check_licence_copy.py compares scripts/licence_scan.py (docstring excluded) and the shared policy sections with the Portal commit pinned in scripts/licence-scan.pin (b93bbc0edebd1a949c31fdee4587ae4a348b54ad)

limits: Source and lock inputs only: no released binary or OCI digest has been scanned; the release-key and environment approval remain open.

The licence detector assigns BSD-Source-Code to the Go BSD 3-clause text; the reviewed-as record, pinned to the file hash, covers the seven Portal modules and two in Apps. A new golang.org/x module is not covered until the owner adds it.
golang/freetype's dual licence is recorded as an election with the upstream dual licence in 'offered'; no tool verifies the upstream dual licence itself.
apps/status/tests (not shipped) and templates/react-app (no lockfile) are not scanned.
The Apps copy of the evaluator and shared policy is compared with a pinned Portal commit; a Portal change not yet copied is visible only as a pin that is behind.
